roadmap.title: Early story, Berty and quality dress
roadmap.description: Play the main story through the early events. Pick the leech for Vivian, and aim for one perfect-quality dress.

roadmap.title: Late story and client chains
roadmap.description: Keep following the main story through the remaining events, finishing all ten clients' commissions and the ruffle skirt dress.

roadmap.title: Big dress and pigeon requests
roadmap.description: With plenty of money, make one huge dress for the trim, cost and accessory goals, and finish all pigeon requests.

achievements.description: Use more than 50m of trim on a single dress.
achievements.summary: Use over 50m of trim in total on one finished dress.

guide.context: Buy 51m of one trim type and use all of it, because exactly 50m may not register. Some laces do not count.

steps.text: Buy 51m of a trim.
Place all 51m on one dress. A large skirt gives the most room.
Finish the dress.

achievements.description: Spend more than 5 000 gold on a successful dress.
achievements.summary: Spend over 5,000 gold on materials for one successful dress.

guide.context: Cost counts the fabric you actually use plus accessories. Gemstones, brooches and some trims are costly. Wait until you can afford many expensive materials.

steps.text: Make a dress from expensive fabric and cover it with costly accessories such as gemstones and brooches until its material cost passes 5,000 gold.
Meet the client's requests and hand the dress in as a commission, sale or gift.

achievements.description: Complete the ruffle skirt for the first time.
achievements.summary: Finish a dress that uses the ruffle skirt.

guide.context: The ruffle skirt uses a lot of fabric. @npc{Priya} gives you the pattern at friendship level 3. @npc{Alice}'s skirt does not count.

steps.text: Raise your friendship with @npc{Priya} to level 3 to get the ruffle skirt.
Buy plenty of fabric, then sew a dress with the ruffle skirt in a commission, sale or gift.

achievements.description: Place over 300 accessories on one dress.
achievements.summary: Have more than 300 accessories placed on a single dress.

guide.context: Each placed item counts. Hold Shift to keep placing the same accessory. This pairs well with the 5,000-gold dress.

steps.text: Buy at least 301 of one accessory, such as gemstones.
Hold Shift and place them all on one dress.
Finish the dress.

achievements.description: Pick the leech when Vivian asks about animals.
achievements.summary: Answer "A leech" when @npc{Vivian} asks about animals.

guide.context: @npc{Vivian} asks this only once, so a wrong answer needs an earlier save. It does not hurt your friendship with her.

steps.text: Play until @npc{Vivian} sends her pigeon request. Her briefing comes after the Love Labyrinth commission.
When she asks about animals, pick @item{A leech}.

achievements.displayName: Birds of a Feather, Frock Together
achievements.description: Complete all the commissions received via pigeon.
achievements.summary: Complete every commission delivered by pigeon.

guide.context: Requests stay available and each one raises friendship. If a client already has a dress waiting, hand that in first or the pigeon skips them.

steps.text: Whenever Berty stands on the perch, open the pigeon request.
Finish each request. Eight clients send one: Prudence, Fiona, Rose, Priya, Marie, Vivian, Dorothy and Edith.

achievements.displayName: 99 Problems But A Stitch Ain't One
achievements.description: Achieve 100% quality on a dress
achievements.summary: Finish a dress with 100% quality.

guide.context: Your measurements must match the requested numbers exactly. The mannequin can show 100% accuracy even when they are slightly off.

steps.text: Meet every client request and enter the exact measurements.
Place each pattern piece to get 100% grain.
Sew slowly, especially around corners, until every seam is 100%. Sewing assist in the options does not lower your score.
Finish the dress.
